facts.business: The company has discontinued manufacturing of paper and paper board and is currently engaged in trading activities in plastic and packaging materials, with plans to commence real estate development and allied activities.
key_risks: Transition risk from manufacturing to trading and planned real estate development
Execution risk in new real estate business
Dependence on trading activities for current revenue
facts.related_party_note: The company has a policy for related party transactions, and the audit committee pre-approves such transactions. Schedule of related party transactions and year-end balances were obtained and reviewed by the auditor.
